# Dial: the pet grows with its agent's context

Rendered by the firmware's own Focus face code (`focus.c`) on the host, at the dial's 466×466, over a one-line recap.
Level 0 is under 50% of the context window, 1 from 50% to under 80%, 2 from 80%: Claude in its own plump and fat
drawings, the other pets widened about 1.3x and 1.6x (1.1x taller) with sweat drops.
